verdict.rationale: Jan's API reference documents POST /v1/messages as an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint on the local server at 127.0.0.1:1337, with curl examples and sample responses. It automatically translates requests so Anthropic SDK clients can point at the local server, and the desktop docs separately advertise connecting Jan with Claude Code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint works, and documentation of which Anthropic features (streaming, tool use) /v1/messages supports, unlike the explicitly described chat-completions endpoint.
